title: Runtime Supply Chain Attack Surface Enumeration Tool for Agentic Pipelines

original_idea.body:
# Runtime Supply Chain Attack Surface Enumeration Tool for Agentic Pipelines

**Problem:** Jiang et al. 2026 identifies the runtime attack surface conceptually, but no enumeration tool exists to automatically identify the attack surface components in a given agentic pipeline.

**Direction:** Build a Python tool that takes a LangChain or LlamaIndex agent configuration and outputs a structured report listing all runtime attack surface components (external tool calls, retrieval endpoints, inter-agent channels, context sources). Validate against three example pipelines. Produce a risk-level score per component.

**Why it matters:** Security teams cannot protect what they cannot enumerate. An automated attack surface mapper for agentic pipelines would be immediately useful for practitioners.

**Relevant context:** Jiang et al. 2026 runtime supply chain taxonomy; LangChain/LlamaIndex agent architectures; security assessment tooling.
